record: Public copy of the curation record that is kept beside the source repository (reference/curation.json there): the decision, reason and public replacements for each of the 261 core tools declared by the public ToolsEnabled engine at the commit under "source", without the live-source fields. tools/audit-package.js reads it when the source record is absent and checks it against the source record otherwise.
sourceMethod: Latest public main reviewed as source; new portable implementation. No legacy engine registry/provider modules are loaded.
sourceDefinitionScope: 261 explicit core define declarations; optional owner tool packs are not counted or shipped.
